hero.eyebrow: A short guide for businesses and brands
hero.title: What is a QR code and how do you use it well?
hero.pageSubtitle: A short guide for businesses and brands — how to use it right
hero.lead: A QR code is a smart shortcut from the physical world to digital: scan with a camera and go straight to a page, file, form, WhatsApp, contact, or Wi-Fi — no typing and no dropped users.

heroPoints.fast: Faster path to action without manual typing
heroPoints.update: With a dynamic QR you can update the destination after printing
heroPoints.stats: Measure scans and see what actually works

flex.label: More flexibility
flex.text: when you need to change the target

useCases.title: Where QR codes really save time
useCases.subtitle: When you give customers a direct path to the right place, they are far more likely to take the next step.

site.title: Website or landing page
site.text: Send someone from a flyer, package, or sign straight to the right page — no URL typing.

wifi.title: Guest Wi-Fi
wifi.text: One scan and they join the network without wrestling a long password.

pdf.title: Menu, catalog, or PDF
pdf.text: Show up-to-date content cleanly without reprinting every version.

leads.title: Leads, WhatsApp, and inquiries
leads.text: Shorten the path to action and raise the chance they continue to the next step.

workflow.title: Three simple steps
workflow.subtitle: Keep it simple: pick a goal, design for scanning, then publish.

goal.title: Choose one clear destination
goal.text: Website, PDF, contact, WhatsApp, or Wi-Fi. The clearer the goal, the better the scan experience.

design.title: Design for easy scanning
design.text: Keep strong contrast, a sensible logo size, and an error-correction level that matches real use.

publish.title: Send to print or digital
publish.text: Place it on a sign, flyer, package, screen, or business card — and make sure the phone handoff feels fast.

differentiator.title: What our site offers that others don't
differentiator.intro: Most QR sites rely on dynamic-only models: after a scan limit the code is blocked and you're asked to pay heavily to turn it back on. Sites that do offer real static codes usually ship basic design and low-quality downloads. Here, the approach is the opposite.

items.title: Static QR — free, pro, yours
items.text: Market-leading design, full-quality PNG or SVG downloads, with no scan caps or expiry. The code stays yours — print and display it anywhere.

items.title: Dynamic — only when you need measurement
items.text: Want to change a destination after printing or track traffic? Dynamic is there for your management. It's not the default and not the only tool — it's an option you choose.

items.title: No unnecessary tracking
items.text: On static codes we don't see who scanned and don't keep scan lists. With dynamic measurement, the data serves you — we don't sell data about your audience.

items.title: Quality, security, and UX — free
items.text: Solid security, a smooth interface, and a professional result — without paying for the basic freedom to create a code that works.

compare.title: Which fits you?
compare.subtitle: The difference is simple: is the destination fixed, or do you need flexibility after the code is out in the world?

static.title: Best for content that does not change
static.text: The data is encoded in the code itself, so you cannot swap the destination after printing.
static.item1: Fixed Wi-Fi, phone, email, or an unchanging page
static.item2: Simple and fast when you do not need ongoing management

dynamic.title: Best for campaigns and live content
dynamic.text: The code points to an intermediate URL, so you can update the destination and track scans even after printing.
dynamic.item1: Changing offers, landing pages, and marketing campaigns
dynamic.item2: Update targets and measure performance without reprinting

benefits.title: What QR gives a business
items: Less friction between discovery and action
Instant bridge from physical to digital
Works for signage, print, packaging, and screens
Dynamic codes let you change destinations without reprinting

tips.title: How to choose
items: If the content is fixed and unlikely to change, static is usually enough.
If you run campaigns, promotions, or need measurement, prefer dynamic.
One QR with one clear goal beats packing too much into a single scan.

summary.title: A good QR is not only pretty — it is clear, fast, and easy to scan.
summary.text: When you set one clear goal, choose static vs dynamic wisely, and keep the handoff simple, the QR becomes a real marketing tool — not just a technical gadget.
